svg.title: Anatomy: geometry, moving parts and effects
svg.desc: An editorial cutaway turbine on a bolted test stand. A shaft joins three blade stages inside a partial cylindrical housing. Dashed airflow passes through the machine and exits as exhaust. Callouts distinguish SVG structure, moving geometry and the WebGL effect layer. This illustration uses SVG animation; it is not generated by Anatomy and does not run WebGL.
svg.text: Cutaway turbine · shared isometric axes · editorial illustration
